verdict.rationale: Oneleet lists ISO 27001 among the frameworks its platform supports [oneleet-docs-29]. Its docs describe frameworks that automatically add controls to a workspace [oneleet-docs-15], which suggests the framework is integrated rather than merely mapped. However, nothing in the pack shows ISO-specific depth such as the current Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or certification-audit deliverables. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO certification-audit artifacts and auditor workflow, and independent corroboration of ISO 27001 depth.
